parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: A sample of a radioactive isotope contains $N$ nuclei of the isotope at time $T$. At time $(T + \Delta T)$, the sample contains $(N - \Delta N)$ nuclei of the isotope. The time interval $\Delta T$ is short. Use the symbols $N$, $\Delta N$, $T$ and $\Delta T$ to give expressions for:
parts.text: the average activity of the sample during the time $\Delta T$

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: the probability of decay of a nucleus in the time $\Delta T$

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: the decay constant $\lambda$ of the isotope.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.stem: The polonium-208 nucleus is initially stationary. The initial kinetic energy of the $^{4}_{2}\text{He}$ nucleus ($\alpha$-particle) is found to be less than the energy calculated in (i) part 2.
parts.text: Suggest two possible reasons for this difference.
